source.test: detectJavaFlavor (unmatched jar name falls back to Paper)

notes: None of the NeoForge/Forge/Fabric/Purpur/vanilla signatures match, so step 6 falls back to `jars.first(where: hasPrefix "paper") ?? jars.first` (line 432) — since no jar's filename starts with "paper" either, the sole jar ("server-runner.jar") is picked by the `?? jars.first` fallback and labelled .paper anyway. parseJarMCVersion then requires an exact "paper-" prefix on the stem, which "server-runner" doesn't have, so detectedMCVersion is null — an observed absence, not a default.
